description: Chat with the latent-mem-lab model: COCONUT-style latent thoughts over frozen Qwen2.5, recall from the CodeTerm mem bank via the reverse projector, a latent router deciding think/recall/speak. Requires the lab server: python3 latent_loop.py serve
configHelp: System instructions are unsupported by this plugin and its current latent-mem-lab server. Agent spawning is refused when the host supplies a launch system prompt. Use a backend supporting session configuration. Start the model server first: cd ~/Developer/latent-mem-lab && python3 latent_loop.py serve --port 8765. Then open a tab with this backend.
